paragraphs: SilverRide runs an assisted transportation platform for older adults and people with disabilities, licensed as a Transportation Network Company in 18 states. The driver network is made up of credentialed independent contractors using their own vehicles across 35+ major metro areas.

The company works three ways: paratransit partnerships with transit agencies, contract services for PACE and healthcare organizations, and direct booking for riders and their families. For transit agencies the service is ADA-compliant paratransit at scale, including complementary service, overflow capacity, premium tiers, and same-day trips. For PACE programs and healthcare organizations the service is door-through-door, with the driver escorting riders from inside the pickup location into the destination.
SilverRide was founded in 2006 by Jeff Maltz and Susan Steiner Saal. The company reports more than one million rides every year with 95% on-time performance.

quote.text: One platform. Three types of partnerships. The same standard of care on every ride.
